name: PMMSY: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture - Haryana
briefDescription: The subsidy for Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for saline/alkaline water aquaculture in newly created water bodies to expand fisheries production in Haryana.
descriptionMd: The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture, introduced by the Ministry Of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of India, aims to provide input cost subsidy for saline/alkaline water aquaculture in newly created water bodies. This centrally sponsored scheme is jointly funded 50% by the Central Government and 50% by the State Government. It supports input costs for the initial crop in new ponds/tanks, encouraging fish and shrimp culture in Haryana.
benefitsMd:
- The project cost is ₹6,00,000/- per hectare.

> **Subsidy Distribution:**


1. 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries
1. 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant must have a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
1. The applicant must create new water bodies under the scheme to receive input cost subsidy.
1. The applicant will receive central assistance for input costs only for the initial crop in newly constructed ponds/tanks.
1. The applicant must ensure the ponds/tanks are fully ready for fish or shrimp culture before claiming input cost assistance.
1. The applicant may also use land on a long-term registered lease, provided the lease period is at least 7 years.
